API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APISSL Inspection PolicySSL Inspection Rule Resource Add SSL Inspection Rule
SSL Inspection Rule Resource Add SSL Inspection Rule
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/sslInspectionRules

Creates a new SSL inspection rule

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

The SSL inspection rule information

name
string
REQUIRED

Rule name

order
int32
REQUIRED

Order of rule execution with respect to other SSL inspection rules.

rank
int32
REQUIRED

Admin rank assigned to this rule

locations
object[]
locationGroups
object[]
departments
object[]
groups
object[]
users
object[]
platforms
string[]

Zscaler Client Connector device platforms for which the rule must be applied. If not set, rule is applied to all device platforms

Possible values: [SCAN_IOS, SCAN_ANDROID, SCAN_MACOS, SCAN_WINDOWS, NO_CLIENT_CONNECTOR, SCAN_LINUX]

roadWarriorForKerberos
boolean

When set to true, the rule is applied to remote users that use PAC with Kerberos authentication. Otherwise, it is a don't care.

urlCategories
object[]
cloudApplications
object[]
action
object
REQUIRED
state
string

State whether it is enabled, disabled, or just set to monitoring

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

description
string

Description provided by the administrator.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the rule was last modified. Ignore if the request is POST or PUT. For GET, ignore if the rule is for the current version.

lastModifiedBy
object[]
destIpGroups
object[]
sourceIpGroups
object[]
proxyGateways
object[]
userAgentTypes
string[]

User agent type list

Possible values: [OPERA, FIREFOX, MSIE, MSEDGE, CHROME, SAFARI, OTHER, MSCHREDGE, BRAVE]

devices
object[]
deviceGroups
object[]
deviceTrustLevels
string[]

List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your posture configurations in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

Possible values: [ANY, UNKNOWN_DEVICETRUSTLEVEL, LOW_TRUST, MEDIUM_TRUST, HIGH_TRUST]

labels
object[]
zpaAppSegments
object[]
workloadGroups
object[]
timeWindows
object[]
defaultRule
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether the rule is the default rule or not

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

System generated identifier for the SSL inspection rule

accessControl
string

Access privilege to this rule based on the admin's RBA

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

name
string
REQUIRED

Rule name

order
int32
REQUIRED

Order of rule execution with respect to other SSL inspection rules.

rank
int32
REQUIRED

Admin rank assigned to this rule

locations
object[]
locationGroups
object[]
departments
object[]
groups
object[]
users
object[]
platforms
string[]

Zscaler Client Connector device platforms for which the rule must be applied. If not set, rule is applied to all device platforms

Possible values: [SCAN_IOS, SCAN_ANDROID, SCAN_MACOS, SCAN_WINDOWS, NO_CLIENT_CONNECTOR, SCAN_LINUX]

roadWarriorForKerberos
boolean

When set to true, the rule is applied to remote users that use PAC with Kerberos authentication. Otherwise, it is a don't care.

urlCategories
object[]
cloudApplications
object[]
action
object
REQUIRED
state
string

State whether it is enabled, disabled, or just set to monitoring

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

description
string

Description provided by the administrator.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the rule was last modified. Ignore if the request is POST or PUT. For GET, ignore if the rule is for the current version.

object[]

object[]
proxyGateways
object[]

string[]

User agent type list

Possible values: [OPERA, FIREFOX, MSIE, MSEDGE, CHROME, SAFARI, OTHER, MSCHREDGE, BRAVE]

devices
object[]
deviceGroups
object[]
deviceTrustLevels
string[]

List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your posture configurations in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

Possible values: [ANY, UNKNOWN_DEVICETRUSTLEVEL, LOW_TRUST, MEDIUM_TRUST, HIGH_TRUST]

labels
object[]
zpaAppSegments
object[]
workloadGroups
object[]
timeWindows
object[]
predefined
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether the rule is a predefined SSL inspection rule or not

defaultRule
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether the rule is the default rule or not
